drums.tags: Funk-rock bass stem. A four-string electric bass guitar plays a syncopated, percussive riff featuring frequent hammer-ons, pull-offs, and ghost notes. The tone is bright and punchy with a slight mid-range growl, characteristic of a bridge pickup on a solid-body bass. The performance follows a 4/4 time signature at 110 BPM in the key of E minor. The riff centers on a low E root note, utilizing the minor pentatonic scale with chromatic passing tones. The articulation is aggressive, with a consistent sixteenth-note subdivision and heavy emphasis on the downbeat of each measure.

bass.tags: Funk-rock instrumental with a heavy emphasis on syncopated rhythmic interplay. The track features a clean, percussive electric guitar playing muted 16th-note scratches and staccato chords. A prominent electric bass guitar performs a slap-and-pop technique, locking tightly with a dry, punchy drum kit. The drums utilize a crisp snare and a tight hi-hat pattern with occasional open accents. A bright, brassy synthesizer or horn section provides staccato melodic stabs. The arrangement is built on a repetitive, high-energy groove with sudden stops and rhythmic unisons. 115 BPM, E minor, 4/4 time signature.
